Ce champignon produit une substance blanchâtre et laiteuse qui durcit après avoir été appliquée sur une blessure. La couche ainsi formée stoppe l'hémorragie, referme matériellement l'ouverture de la plaie et contribue à la protéger contre l'infection. This fungus is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in underground environments, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

This fungus produces a milky white substance that hardens when applied to a wound. The resulting layer stops bleeding, physically seals the opening and helps protect it against infection. These three effects make it particularly useful where ordinary dressings would be inadequate.
